bio: This little restaurant is located in the middle of the old town, in a narrow side street near the Eiermarkt. The dining area has a rustic feel and tightly packed table, which contributes to the charming atmosphere, as does the cordial proprietress, who is in charge of the service. The delicious options are written on the blackboard and also come in smaller portions as a surprise menu. The impressive wine list features around 230 labels....
